fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-06-09 at roughly 03:20, it was reported that a black motorcycle bearing registration number TN-39-XX-1078 was found missing from the parking space near Vennila Puram Shopping Complex. Arjun Pandian approached Erode South PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000330. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Tamilarasan Muthu, using the number 9000000260. Manoj Karuppasamy (9000000054) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. A further person, Gokul Sundaram, a neighbour, using the number 9000000491, is stated to be associated with the incident. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle reportedly taken from an unattended parking area.
fields.Keywords: motorcycle theft, vehicle, shopping complex, witness, motorcycle, CCTV, mobile number, night
